entities.name: Risona
entities.description: A human samurai and artificer of Kamigawa, leader of the Asari Uprisers, now a prisoner of the Imperial Palace.

entities.name: Asari Uprisers
entities.description: Artisans and warriors led by Risona who believe the empire should be abolished.

entities.name: Sokenzanshi
entities.description: Mountain town where Risona was born and which fell short on food one deadly winter.

entities.name: Imperial Court
entities.description: Court that fell into chaos when the emperor disappeared.

entities.name: Emperor
entities.description: Planeswalking emperor who briefly returned to lead troops against the Uprisers.

events.summary: After the emperor vanishes, the Imperial Court falls into chaos and Sokenzanshi starves in winter; Risona loses trust in the Court.
events.quote: Risona would never trust the Imperial Court again.

events.summary: Risona and fellow artisans and warriors form the Asari Uprisers and plan a coup.
events.quote: Many of her fellow artisans and warriors joined her and formed the Asari Uprisers.

events.summary: The Uprisers attack Eiganjo and are defeated by Imperial troops under the briefly returned Emperor; Risona is imprisoned.
events.quote: Risona is currently a prisoner of the Imperial Palace.

relations.quote: She is the leader of the Asari Uprisers

relations.note: planned a coup against the Imperials
relations.quote: The planned a coup to replace the Imperials with a government that would have its citizens' interest at heart.
